messages:
incident-bot: [31mALERT[0m cross-region routing anomaly detected: elevated 502/504 for eu customers beginning ~1946007600. Tagging oncall.
rebecca: noticed a jump in cross-region hops for eu-west -> us-east. Error rate ~9% for eu API shards. Paging Owen and Kai.
owen: on it. Any recent routing policy changes?
kai: yes, late morning change to latency-steering weights (PR #960). I can revert but want to confirm it's the cause.
rebecca: traces show that some sessions that were pinned to eu-west started going to us-east around 07:06 UTC. Hop count +2 and p99 latency doubled.
netops: checking central route-manager logs, seeing a promotion event around 07:05:57 that set eu weight -> global fallback.
sre-lead: assign mitigation. Priority: force regional pin for EU to avoid cross-region hops.
owen: running emergency command: `rctl routes enforce --region eu --mode pin --duration 600 --reason "emergency-mitigation"`
owen: command accepted. Edge responses should flip within 20-40s.
kai: while that's propagating, I'm pulling canary evaluator logs. Looks like the canary evaluator window shortened during a maintenance task and misread p99. snippet:```text
[2026-06-12T07:05:57Z] canary-eval: window_ms=15000, samples=12, p99=210ms -> promotion triggered
[2026-06-12T07:05:57Z] rollout: promote -> global-fallback
```
rebecca: that matches. We need a guard to avoid promotions when sample count < 50.
liaison: customer OPS reporting: "Some EU traffic is failing, customers see intermittent 502s. Any ETA?" We're notifying that an emergency pin is in place.
sre-lead: confirm telemetry after pin.
netops: initial telemetry: cross-region hops falling, 502 rate down from 9% -> 2.8% in first 90s. Good.
owen: note — we still have a route cache TTL bug: some CDNs cached the promoted policy and will honor it for ~4m unless we purge. Working on purge script.
rebecca: can we nuke the route cache for eu-edge? Command?
netops: `edgectl cache purge --region eu --keys route-policy-v2` in progress.
kai: rolling back PR #960 now: `git revert e3b9f4` then `rctl policy apply --from-git HEAD~1`.
sre-lead: keep rollback and override in place until caches clear and telemetry stable for 10m.
liaison: updating customers: "We applied a regional pin and rolled back a routing change. Monitoring; we'll send a full postmortem."
oncall-eu: acknowledged handoff in 30m. I'll watch the override TTL and cache purge progress.
owen: cache purge completed for primary eu edges. Secondary caches still draining.
rebecca: 10m after mitigation: 502 down to 0.7%. Cross-region traces almost gone.
kai: adding immediate fixes: 1) prevent auto-promotion when sample_count < 40; 2) require p95 and p99 checks with stable windows; 3) add cross-region hop synthetic monitor. I'll open PRs.
sre-lead: create incident ticket RTE-5242 and assign owners. Also require customer postmortem and SOC review.
liaison: customers notified with interim summary; they requested timing and RCA. We'll coordinate postmortem draft.
oncall-eu: watching. If anything regresses I'll reopen and page.
incident-bot: Incident status: mitigated -> partial. Action: postmortem required. Severity S3. Ticket RTE-5242 recorded.
rebecca: final notes for handoff: emergency pin active until TTLs clear, rollback completed, cache purge mostly complete, PRs for evaluator and monitor incoming.
owen: I'll own cache-edge validation and purge automation.
kai: I'll own evaluator guards and add synthetic hop-check.
sre-lead: good. Close thread once RTE-5242 has initial postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
